text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-t-a-g-e-d a n-i-g-h-t f-a-l-l, d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-i-n-g t-h-e i-n-j-u-r-y s-c-e-n-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g o-f-f-i-c-i-a-l i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t r-e-p-o-r-t-i-n-g
2) t-h-e y o u t-h e l-p-e-r t-a-u-g-h-t c-o-w-o-r-k-e-r-s t-h-e i-n-j-u-r-y s-t-o-r-y, l-e-a-v-i-n-g s-u-s-p-i-c-i-o-u-s c-h-a-t l-o-g-s a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g w-i-t-n-e-s-s v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-q-u-e-s-t-e-d m-e-d-i-c-a-l r-e-c-o-r-d e-d-i-t-s, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g f-a-l-s-i-f-i-e-d c-l-a-i-m f-o-r-m-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g p-r-o-f-e-s-s-i-o-n-a-l l-i-c-e-n-s-e r-e-v-i-e-w
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-l-a-i-m-e-d w-o-r-k-p-l-a-c-e l-i-a-b-i-l-i-t-y, f-i-l-i-n-g i-n-s-u-r-a-n-c-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g l-e-g-a-l c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e r-e-v-i-e-w
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r p-r-e-p-a-r-e-d f-o-r i-n-s-u-r-e-r s-c-r-u-t-i-n-y, m-a-i-n-t-a-i-n-i-n-g c-o-v-e-r s-t-o-r-y d-e-t-a-i-l-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k-s

f-r-e-e-l-a-n-c-e r-o-l-e n-o-r-m-s f-o-r p-r-e-v-e-n-t-i-o-n: r-e-q-u-i-r-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t r-e-p-o-r-t-s w-i-t-h i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n, p-e-r-f-o-r-m r-o-u-t-i-n-e a-u-d-i-t-s o-f m-e-d-i-c-a-l d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t s-t-a-t-u-s, t-r-a-i-n a-l-l s-t-a-f-f o-n e-t-h-i-c-a l c-l-a-i-m h-a-n-d-l-i-n-g p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l-s, i-m-p-l-e-m-e-n-t r-a-n-d-o-m s-a-m-p-l-i-n-g f-o-r i-n-s-u-r-a-n-c-e c-l-a-i-m v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n, a-n-d m-a-i-n-t-a-i-n c-l-e-a-r a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l-s f-o-r a-l-l m-e-d-i-c-a l r-e-c-o-r-d m-o-d-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n-s
